heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: BNPB's national count holds the toll at 127 dead and 166,829 displaced after the M7.7 quake that struck 68km NNW of Ende on 15 August, but East Nusa Tenggara's provincial disaster agency (BPBD NTT) reported diverging figures on 5 September — 130 dead and displacement down sharply to 96,385 — the sharpest provincial-vs-national gap of the response, still unreconciled. BMKG's aftershock count has passed 12,000 (12,438 per BPBD NTT, 12,064 per BNPB), including two new felt M4.6 tremors near Mbay/Nagekeo and Ruteng that caused no damage. Homes damaged has risen to 99,568, and NTT's governor has pledged layered oversight of incoming relief funds.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
